title: Event-driven agent
subtitle: A runnable Event-Driven Agent
description: A fraud-investigation agent that only exists because an external webhook fired - no form, no polling, no scheduled job. While the agent is mid-investigation, a second, independent webhook can interrupt it at any moment via a message boundary event: a customer-confirmed-fraud report always wins over whatever the agent was reasoning about, structurally, not by prompt instruction.
creator: Camunda
thumbnailAlt: BPMN model: a webhook start event feeding a Fraud Investigation Agent ad-hoc subprocess, which can be interrupted at any time by a second webhook (an interrupting message boundary event) that routes straight to freezing the card and a human handoff, bypassing whatever the agent was doing.
